title: Describing symptoms and appointments
summary: Use the indicated lemma and case. With боліти, the body part is the subject: singular болить, plural болять.

ache-sing.note: The verb agrees with the aching part, so it is singular here.

ache-plur.note: With a plural subject the verb is plural.

cough-gen.sentenceGloss: After treatment the cough is gone.

nose-gen.sentenceGloss: This description does not mention symptoms of rhinitis.
nose-gen.note: Genitive singular: нежить in the second case singular after симптоми.

pressure-gen.sentenceGloss: The nurse recorded the pressure reading.
pressure-gen.note: Genitive: показник тиску — the pressure reading.

pharmacy-loc.sentenceGloss: My sister works at a pharmacy.
pharmacy-loc.note: Locative singular: аптека in the second case singular.

prescription-gen.sentenceGloss: The text contains the prescription number.
prescription-gen.note: Genitive: номера рецепта — of the prescription.

dermatologist-gen.sentenceGloss: Taras made an appointment with a dermatologist.

ointment-gen.sentenceGloss: The name of the ointment is written on the package.
ointment-gen.note: Genitive: назву мазі — the name of the ointment.

weakness-inst.sentenceGloss: The patient describes their condition as “with considerable weakness”.
weakness-inst.note: Instrumental: зі takes the instrumental — with considerable weakness.

medicine-gen.sentenceGloss: These medicines are not on the list.
medicine-gen.note: Genitive plural: цих ліків — of these medicines.
